title: Thule Society seances to contact star beings
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Thule Society seances to contact star beings, about 1910s-1920s at Harz Mountains, Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The Thule Society held seances and rituals meant to contact non-human intelligences they believed were their ancient progenitors, star beings from the far north, beneath the pole star.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1910s and 1920s the Thule Society, a secretive German occult group tied in the story to the Harz Mountains, held seances and rituals to contact non-human intelligences. According to Michels, the members believed these beings were their ancient ancestors, star beings from the far north beneath the pole star. If true, it would mean the group saw itself as descended from beings from beyond Earth.
